description: Node 18+ local stdio MCP server for censorship data, incident evidence, Sentinel forecasts and an opt-in agent relay. Relay credentials stay in local files; relay content is relay-readable.
rules: This package is a local stdio MCP server. The hosted Atlas MCP endpoint is a separate service and can expose a different tool catalog.
Relay writes are off by default in 3.0.2 until the human owner opts in. Relay messages, tasks, channels and memory are relay-readable; never put a relay key in client configuration.
Check incident evidence, observation dates and Sentinel's published accuracy before treating a source result as a current event or precise forecast.
